newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish NFI units to expire Dec 31, 1998.
newsitem.headline: Polish NFI units to expire Dec 31, 1998.

text.p: The Polish government on Tuesday said that National Investment Fund (NFI) units, which are part of the country's privatisation programme, will expire on December 31 next year.
"It has been decided that mass privatisation certificates will cease to be valid on December 31, 1998," the government press office said in a statement.

Under the mass privatisaiotn plan, each of the 26 million adult Poles who bought the certificate last year will be able to exchange it for 15 shares of the NFIs -- one share in each fund -- from May 12.
The funds, privately managed by Polish-foreign consortia, together run more than 500 companies, which took part in the programme.
